answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the sparrow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cedar of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
